call_points.text: Completed successful trial of new-generation discharge system with marquee South American copper customer, securing order for a second mine.
Planned FY27 capex restricted to ₹100 Cr-₹150 Cr for maintenance and renewable power balancing.
Ghana and China expansion projects placed on slowdown mode pending regulatory approvals and volume traction.
Management abstained from giving specific annual volume growth targets, preferring long-term strategic conversion metrics.
Global supply chain disruptions, rising freight volatility, and country-level protectionist trade measures persist as headwinds.

operating_notes.text: Discontinued manufacturing operations at Nagpur unit on 29 July 2025 without adverse impact on operations.
Installed capacity stands at 4,36,000 TPA as of March 2026.
Outstanding foreign currency forward sales contracts include US$ 16.50 million as of May 21, 2026.
Mining segment accounted for 1,59,813 MT of sales in FY26.
Q4FY26 sales realization reached ₹178/kg, supported by product mix and ₹65 Cr foreign exchange gain.
FY26 sales volume stood at 2,58,000 MT (1,60,000 MT mining, 98,000 MT non-mining).
Current capacity utilization is around 55% of 4,36,000 TPA total capacity.
Q1 volumes were 64,644 tonnes against about 60,000 tonnes in Q1FY26, with capacity of 430,000-440,000 tonnes.
The Chile high-chrome grinding media order is supplying about 3,000-3,500 tonnes per quarter.
Freight is around $8,000-9,000 a container and still elevated but easing; ferrochrome prices are on the higher side.

timeline.summary: Bhadresh K. Shah, Gita B. Shah, Bhumika S. Shodhan, and Khushali S. Solanki declared no encumbrance on AIA Engineering shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 3, 2026.
AIA Engineering declared ₹16/share dividend, reappointed MD Bhadresh Shah for 5 years, and provided ₹3.28 Cr WSL closure compensation.
AIA Engineering reported Q4FY26 EBITDA margins of 39.7% and an order book of ₹868 Cr as of April 2026.
AIA Engineering Limited shared the audio recording of its Investor Call on financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26 ended March 31, 2026, via its website.
Tushar Vora & Associates, Scrutinizer, reported AIA Engineering’s postal ballot voting results via CDSL’s e-voting system (29 Apr–28 May 2026) under SEBI’s Regulation 44(3).
AIA Engineering reported a breakthrough trial win for its new discharge system in South America during its Q4FY26 concall.

AIA Engineering's 12 August 2026 Q1FY27 call reported sales of ₹1,153 Cr and PAT of ₹301 Cr on 64,644 tonnes, with management deferring volume guidance by a quarter and raising FY27 capex guidance to ₹350-400 Cr.
CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed AIA Engineering's credit ratings at CRISIL AA+/Stable and CRISIL A1+ for ₹860 Cr of bank loan facilities.
AIA Engineering Limited will hold an Investors' conference call on Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter/Half Year ended 30 September 2026 on Tuesday, 3 November 2026 at 04.30 p.m. IST.
